name: GridCraft
summary: Edit Excel spreadsheets in Nextcloud with GridCraft
description:
Open an Excel workbook (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xlsb, .xls), an OpenDocument spreadsheet (.ods) or a CSV file in Files with **Edit in GridCraft** and work on it right in the browser: formulas and functions, formatting, tables, charts, PivotTables, sorting and filtering, notes and comments.

- **Save** writes an .xlsx workbook straight back to Nextcloud, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version. Other formats are saved as a new .xlsx file next to the original (you pick the name and folder).
- **Export as PDF** stores a file in any folder you pick.
- Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy.
- If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy.
- Optionally, clicking a spreadsheet in Files opens it in GridCraft.
readme_features:
- **Edit in GridCraft** appears in the Files action menu of every Excel (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xlsb, .xls, .xltx, .xltm), OpenDocument (.ods), CSV and TSV spreadsheet you can read.
- **Save** (Ctrl/⌘+S) writes an .xlsx workbook back to Nextcloud, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version. A workbook opened from another format is saved as .xlsx: the first time, you pick the name and folder (it's offered next to the original), and later saves go to that file.
- **Export as PDF** asks for a name and folder in your Nextcloud the first time.
readme_limitations:
- In the browser GridCraft saves workbooks as .xlsx. A spreadsheet in another format (.xls, .xlsm, .xlsb, .xltx, .xltm, .ods, CSV, TSV) is saved as a new .xlsx file and the original stays as it is.
- GridCraft doesn't run or keep VBA macros: it tells you when it drops them while opening a file.
- In the browser, **Save As** stores the workbook like **Save**, and **Share › Save a Copy** isn't available; to keep a copy under another name, copy the file in Files first.
new_format_hint: GridCraft saves {name} as an Excel workbook (.xlsx), so it goes to a new file and the original stays as it is.
bridge_notes: With `?host=parent`, GridCraft starts with an empty workbook instead of a sample, an optional `&author=<name>` signs the user's notes and comments, and the parent guards leaving the page with unsaved changes. An .xlsx workbook handed to the parent counts as saved under that name.
